chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about urine that hits the body. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Pour water upon it twice, for it is merely water.'
And I asked him (peace be upon him) about clothes hit by urine. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Wash it twice.'
And I asked him (peace be upon him) about a child urinating on the clothes. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Pour a little water upon it, then wring it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the method for purifying urine stains on the body and clothes according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the practical methodology for removing impurity (najāsah) of urine, distinguishing between the body and garments based on the principle of ease. It reflects the Shia juristic view that urine is not inherently defiling in a way that requires extensive washing, but rather requires simple rinsing, with specific concessions for infants to accommodate their frequent urination. This ruling underscores the balance between ritual purity and practicality in daily life.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the urine hitting the body. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Pour the water upon it, twice, for rather, it is water’.
And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the clothes hit by the urine. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wash it twice’.
And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the child urinating upon the clothes. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Pour a little water upon it, then wring it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about urine that pollutes one’s body. He (the Imam) said, Tour water on it twice; it is water.’
I then asked about urine, which pollutes one’s clothes. He (the Imam) said, ‘Wash it twice.’
I then asked him about the urine of a child that pollutes one’s clothes. He (the Imam) said, ‘After pouring a small amount of water on it you must also wring it.’”
